note: Questions a Monash student would ask about special consideration, exams, withdrawing, dates and DSS. Written by the team on 2026-11-10 from the pages in the corpus; gold = page ids that answer the question (any one counts). 'campus' narrows the search the way the desk does when a student picks a campus first; questions without it are searched across every campus. 'student' holds real questions from classmates, collected on 2026-11-11, copied as written with names, student IDs and medical details removed, and published with their consent; they are scored separately (npm run eval:retrieval -- --set student) so the team set's numbers stay comparable. 'outside' holds the student questions these pages do not answer; the local-engine run with --set student checks that the desk says it cannot answer them.
